plan.root_cause: The suggestion list items have tabindex='0', making them focusable and part of the tab order. When the list is open, pressing Tab moves focus to the first suggestion instead of skipping to the next form field.
plan.repair_strategy: Change the tabindex of listbox option elements from '0' to '-1' (or remove) to exclude them from the tab order while preserving arrow-key navigation and screen reader support via aria-activedescendant.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key will now move focus from the city combobox to the next form field (dietary requirements) when the suggestion list is visible, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard operability and providing a logical tab order.
functional_risks: Talkback screen reader may rely on tabindex='0' for option discovery; changing to '-1' could reduce its effectiveness, though aria-activedescendant should still convey selection.
Ensure that mouse selection and Enter key selection remain unaffected.
verification_requirements: Type 'Ber' in the city field to open suggestions, then press Tab and verify focus moves to the dietary requirements field.
Verify that Arrow Up/Down keys still navigate the list and that Enter selects the highlighted suggestion and closes the list.
Confirm that the selected city value is correctly inserted into the input after selection.
